run_math_server: run the math_server.py MCP server to expose add, subtract, multiply, divide, and square_root tools
run_text_server: run the text_server.py MCP server to expose reverse_text, count_words, to_uppercase, and to_lowercase tools
run_utility_server: run the utility_server.py MCP server to expose get_current_time, generate_random_number, and format_json tools
run_todo_server: run the todo_server.py MCP server to expose add_todo, list_todos, complete_todo, and delete_todo tools
run_cli_mcp_server: run the cli_mcp_server.py with a CLI command name to dynamically create MCP tools from CLI help output
